```{=html}
<!-- Lesson 6 navigation dropdown (replaces the old floating sidebar).
     Included at the top of each Lesson 6 page via {{< include _lesson-nav.qmd >}}.
     Edit the menu items here; every page picks up the change. -->
<div class="dropdown lesson-nav mb-4">
  <button class="btn btn-outline-primary dropdown-toggle" type="button"
          id="lessonNavDropdown" data-bs-toggle="dropdown" aria-expanded="false">
    <span class="lesson-nav-label">
      <span class="lesson-nav-lesson">Lesson 6: AI Careers</span>
      <span class="lesson-nav-page">Lesson Contents</span>
    </span>
  </button>
  <ul class="dropdown-menu" aria-labelledby="lessonNavDropdown">
    <li><h6 class="dropdown-header">Lesson Contents</h6></li>
    <li><a class="dropdown-item" href="index.html">1. Overview</a></li>
    <li><a class="dropdown-item" href="workshops.html">2. Review: Workshops</a></li>
    <li><a class="dropdown-item" href="prompting.html">3. Review: Chatbot Prompting</a></li>
    <li><a class="dropdown-item" href="classification.html">4. Review: Classification</a></li>
    <li><a class="dropdown-item" href="regression.html">5. Review: Regression</a></li>
    <li><a class="dropdown-item" href="careers.html">6. AI Careers</a></li>
  </ul>
</div>

<script>
  // Highlight the current page in the dropdown and show it on the button.
  // Runs immediately (the dropdown above is already on the page), so it
  // doesn't wait for Pyodide and the rest of the page to finish loading.
  (function () {
    var page = window.location.pathname.split("/").pop() || "index.html";
    if (!page.endsWith(".html")) page += ".html";
    document.querySelectorAll(".lesson-nav .dropdown-item").forEach(function (a) {
      if (a.getAttribute("href") === page) {
        a.classList.add("active");
        a.setAttribute("aria-current", "page");
        var label = document.querySelector(".lesson-nav .lesson-nav-page");
        if (label) label.textContent = a.textContent.trim();
      }
    });
  })();
</script>
```
